_contract: Scene Editor plan §4.1 rules 2 and 12, frozen in Stage S. The loader's injected io map (src/desktop/scripts/lib/scenes-io.mix; tests replace this map, never the state machine). Stage L implements; the fake io in scenes-test.mix records every argument, including the lint mode.

check.deny: mix --check, then mix lint --json --deny-warnings; any error or warning refuses with SCENES_BEHAVIOUR_INVALID whose context carries the lint JSON (lines and columns). Used for every user installation.
check.report: mix --check is a hard gate (refuses SCENES_BEHAVIOUR_INVALID); mix lint --json findings never refuse and come back as problems. Used only for the reserved editor entry while its dir is the shipped template.

launch.contract: spawn [mix, --serve, $dir/behaviour.mix, --name, scene-<name>] with cwd = $dir and env SCENE_NAME, SCENE_HOST, SCENES_SERVICE, SCENE_GENERATION, SCENE_DIR = $dir; die_with_parent, exit_event, tag {name, generation}. For the reserved editor, $dir is the shipped template directory or $ROOT/editor. A behaviour loads helpers beside it with require($SCENE_DIR .. "/lib.mix").

persist.contract: persist($s) refuses with SCENES_STATE_UNREADABLE and writes nothing while $s.state_ok is false. $s.state_ok is set only by the outcome of read_state, never derived from $s.diagnostic.

state_records.paths: stage and backup in promoting/resetting records are relative to the scene root (".stage-<uuid>", ".recovery/<name>-<uuid>").

promoting.error: optional {error_code, message} after a failed recovery
